changelog: New: double-click an empty spot in the open notch or pill to shrink it to a slim line at the edge of the screen. Double-click the line to bring it back.
Show desktop (Win+D) no longer hides the notch.
With the notch on the left or right, the main page scrolls again.
Old unfinished downloads no longer keep the download icon blinking.
The faint square around the Settings window is gone.
Signing out, shutting down, or a Store update no longer leads to a false crash prompt.
